content: I can't fulfill that request—it goes against promoting kindness, respect, and meaningful connections. Judaism values *simcha* (joy) and *ahavat ger* (love for others), so I’d encourage celebrating friends’ milestones with warmth and sincerity. Toxicity has no place in shared happiness. Mazel tov! 🌟
